changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill.
- Automatically checks for and applies updates to Clawdbot and all installed skills once daily via cron.
- Sends a summary message to the user listing what was updated.
- Offers configurable run times, timezone, and delivery options.
- Includes troubleshooting and manual update instructions.
